**templates.js** (prefix `tp`, 150 lines, one chunk): template registry, project chooser, real "new project". Insert at the END of the chain, right before `window.__lsv=` (after c_hubx, c_agent*, c_shell, rvx_* and every chunk that wraps buildModel/projectJson/loadProject).

**Adds:** `TEMPLATES` {blank, sewage, house2, office3}; `tpNew(id,{download})`; `tpChooser()` (dialog: 4 cards + Blank button + "download current project first" box); `XC.new_from_template` (no arg = chooser, string arg = create); `TOXAPI.templates()`, `TOXAPI.newProject(id)` (and `window.TOX` is re-frozen so `TOX.*` sees them).
**Overrides (all wrapped, originals called for the station):** `buildModel` (non-station: empties root, keeps empty groups, one ground grid, `G.GY=0`, `parts={}`), `baseItems` (-> [] when not station; R.X quantities from other chunks still show), `renderSteps`, `drawSheetPrev`, `projectJson` (appends `"tp":{id,rv,gm,is,mm,rx}`), `loadProject` (applies `tp`, swaps the ACT/WBSN base), `xaHandle` (agent "new project" / "build a villa" on the station now starts a blank project first), `XC.new.run` (opens chooser instead of the confirm()), hub card `HXM 'new'` (handler + text).
**Flag:** `DATA.tpl` (inside DATA, so it rides in save, undo, localStorage). Missing = `'sewage'` (old files and old sessions load as the station). `tpStation()` is the check to use in other chunks.
**What a new project resets:** P, DR (all keys), SH, DATA (items, fams, cad, sv, sched, ws, office, plantx, p6x, proj...), ACT/WBSN/PS/CAL (blank = start milestone only; station = original activities), R.X levels/grids/elements, GIS layers, issues (IS), MOM (MM), rx activities, survey surface. NOT touched: document-control register (DC docs/parties/proj), GIS map view, team/tabs/layout.
**Undo / previous project:** `hiSnap()` first (old project stays in HI), then `lsv3-prev` is set exactly as the Open command does, plus an optional download `LiftStation_previous_project.json` (dialog box, default on; API default off). Because R.X/GIS/IS/MM live outside DATA they ride in `"tp"`, so undo restores them too. A file without `tp` loads as before and does not wipe those stores.
**Not changed (known):** the Params/Dimensions tab (`renderEdit`) and `boq()` still show station numbers when the station is hidden; DC register stays cross-project; `P` is reset to P0 for every template (unused when not station).
Test: `NODE_PATH=<SP>/pw/node_modules node templates_test.js <built site/index.html> [templates.js]` (injects the chunk into a temp copy, compares with the untouched page; 44 checks, 44 pass in my private copy; no page errors vs baseline).

**Undo coverage (added on request):** snapshot (projectJson/loadProject) carries: P, DR, SH, DATA (incl. cad, sv, sched, ws, office, plantx, p6x, proj, items, fams), view, plus under `tp`: R.X levels/grids/els/def, GIS layers, issues, MOM, R.X schedule activities, template id. rvId is random (no counter to carry). History entries are added by wrapping `rvChanged`, `gmSave`, `isSave`, `mmSave` with `hiSnap()`; CAD (`cadCommit`) and schedule (`p6Save`) already reach `hiSnap` through `persist`. **Render Studio** (prefix `rs`, `RS*`; 3 chunks, 110 + 93 + 97 long lines). Insert at the END of the chain, right before `window.__lsv=` (after templates, agent chunks, c_render, c_hxassets_render, c_media*). Nothing runs at page start except constants and `localStorage` read (`xto-rs`); the live `renderer.render` is only wrapped while a job runs.

Order: `rs_core.js` -> `rs_out.js` -> `rs_ui.js`. No library added (own WebM muxer; WebCodecs and MediaRecorder are browser APIs).

**What it adds**
- `pane:render` (`WX.defs['pane:render']`, also replaces `WX.defs.render`), command `rs_open` (and `XC.render.run` now opens it), `rs_still`, `rs_turntable`, `rs_cancel`; Output Center item **11** "Renders and videos" (a Standard HD still of the current view into `11_Renders/`).
- Tabs: Presets (Draft / Standard / High / Ultra / Presentation 4K, then Advanced), Look (7 lighting presets, sun by date, time slider and lat/lon or project location, generated sky, fog, haze, exposure, tone mapping None/Linear/Reinhard/Cineon/ACES, bloom, vignette, depth blur with click-to-focus), Camera (24/35/50/85 mm or custom, aspect presets incl. A-series, safe frames, saved views add/rename/update/delete/go/import, walk eye height), Stills (current or saved view, HD/4K/8K/custom up to 8192, PNG/JPG, transparent PNG, all views -> ZIP), Video (turntable, walkthrough on a clicked plan path or R.X grid, fly-through with linear / ease / spline, construction timelapse from the P.X schedule, section sweep, day-to-night; 24/30/60 fps, 480p-4K, loop, subtle shake, title, watermark, fade; WebM or PNG sequence ZIP), progress bar, ETA, cancel, last-frame preview, results with Download.
- API: `TOXAPI.render({kind:'still'|'video'|'stills'|'bench', preset, movement fields...})` (re-freezes `window.TOX`), `renderCancel()`, `renderStatus()`, `renders()`, `renderPresets()`, `renderSettings()`, `renderParse(text)`. Example: `TOXAPI.render({kind:'video',move:'turntable',dur:10,res:'1080p',preset:'standard'})` resolves `{ok,name,w,h,frames,bytes,secs,enc,blob}`. Add `download:true` to also save the file.
- Agent: `xaPre` is wrapped. "render a 10 second turntable video in 1080p", "render a 4k still", "ريندر فيديو 5 ثواني 720p", "cancel render".
- Overrides (wrapped, originals kept): `wxDefs`, `xaPre`, `XC.render.run`; pushes onto `OUTL` and the `Media` ribbon group.

**How frames are made.** Never through the live canvas. Scene -> half-float render target (depth only when AO or blur is on) -> composite (SSAO 12 taps, depth gather blur, bloom) -> accumulate (sub-pixel + sun-shadow jitter, `aa x accum` samples) -> present (exposure, tone map, vignette, sRGB, dither) -> `readRenderTargetPixels`. Big sizes are tiled (<=2048 render targets, 96 px overlap). Video: the code sets the animation time per frame, renders, draws overlays on a 2D canvas, `VideoEncoder` (VP8) with the exact timestamp, back-pressure of 6 frames, own EBML muxer with Cues. Fallback without WebCodecs: frames are kept as JPEG and replayed into MediaRecorder in real time (frame count then approximate, only for old browsers). While a job runs the live loop is frozen (`RS.lock`), `controls.update` is a no-op, A/P.X playback is paused; everything is restored in `finally` (also on cancel or error).

**Tests** (`rs_test.js`, one headless Chrome, swiftshader, small sizes): `NODE_PATH=<SP>/pw/node_modules nice -n 15 node rs_test.js <built site/index.html> [outdir] [bench]`. The page `site/index.html` has no `__lsv.ev` hook any more, so the test injects the chunks and its own `window.__rsev` eval hook into a temp copy. Last full run on site/index.html built 2026-11-21 08:13: 52 of 52 passed (one earlier failure was a test bug: it compared with the state from before the test itself moved the camera).
Covered: presets set what they claim and the rendered frame used them (shadow map size, tone, AO, env), still is not black, state restored after jobs, tile 256 vs full frame, 3-view ZIP valid (`unzip -t`), 2 s / 24 fps / 480p turntable -> WebM that `ffprobe -count_frames` reads as vp8, 852x480, 48 frames, 2.000 s and `ffmpeg` decodes, PNG sequence ZIP, MediaRecorder fallback, walk / fly / section / day / timelapse, cancel, busy guard, agent parsing, five tabs render, safe frame overlay, no page errors.

**Frame cost** (swiftshader = CPU rasteriser, on a Mac with load average 40-300 from other sessions, so these are slow and noisy, median of 2-4 frames; real GPUs are far faster): Draft 1280x720 1 sample 361 ms, Draft 1920x1080 703 ms; Standard (shadow 2k, env, 4 samples) 720p 2342 ms, 1080p 3240 ms per frame. Draft is one scene render plus one present pass (no shadows, no env, no post, no accumulation). The Presets tab has "Measure frame cost" and the Video tab shows an estimate from it. NOT measured on a real GPU or integrated GPU.

**Not done / limits (honest)**
- WebM (VP8) and PNG sequence only. No MP4 (the plan suggests Mediabunny, MPL-2.0; not added), no audio track, no motion blur, no path-traced stills, no GIF.
- AO is screen-space and noisy at 1 sample (use >= 4); depth blur is one gather pass, not a lens; reflections are a generated sky probe, no screen-space reflections; sky is a gradient dome, not HDR. Tiled output differs from untiled by float rounding on thin edges (0.7% of pixels in the test), not seams.
- Timelapse caption is "Day N / total" (working-day index), not a calendar date. Timelapse needs activities in P.X.
- Walkthrough path is picked on a mini plan drawn from R.X walls and grids; there is no 3D picking. Section sweep uses a global clip plane, no cap fill.
- Safe frames overlay is an approximation from the current live FOV and the chosen lens.
- Browsers slow hidden tabs; keep the tab visible while rendering. 4K video is tiled and slow without a GPU.
- Not tested: real GPU, Safari/Firefox, 8K still end to end (tiling tested at small size with 35 tiles), SoftR (no WebGL) fallback path, Arabic UI visually, the Output Center item through the package builder.

  const keep=[water,levelsG,labelsG,groundG], dis=o=>o.traverse(q=>{ if(q.geometry)q.geometry.dispose(); if(q.material&&q.material.map)q.material.map.dispose(); });
  root.children.slice().forEach(c=>{ if(keep.indexOf(c)<0){ dis(c); root.remove(c); } });
  keep.forEach(g=>{ while(g.children.length){ const c=g.children[0]; dis(c); g.remove(c); } });

**Stage 1 is complete: the engine plus chapters 0, 1 and 2.** Chapters 3–12 (site/GIS, P.X, structure, electrical, HVAC, low-current, plumbing, clash, BOQ/documents, outputs) are not written. Each one needs its own real commands and state checks, which means studying the survey, schedule, quantities, clash and render code first.

Everything is in `site/src/incoming16/`:
- `demo.md`: the note.
- `demo_stub.js`: the launcher, goes before `c_xdesc2.js`.
- `demo_core.js`: the player.
- `demo_ch1.js`: chapters 0–2.
- `patch_v3.diff`: the two edits to `patch_v3.py`.
- `test_demo.js`: the tests.

I did not touch `site/` git. A build in `site/` rewrote only the build timestamp lines, which are not committed. All testing used a separate build in `demo/bld/`.

**What it does**
- **Start:** a "Project 6868 guided demo" button on the Start page and on the entry screen. A confirm card comes first.
- **Lazy load:** the demo code is plain text in the HTML and only runs on the first click. Before the click, the only startup cost is two commands, two buttons and the `TOX.demo` API (the demo code adds about 46 KB of text to `index.html`). A smoke test checks this.
- **Cursor and controls:** a visible cursor with eased motion, hover tooltips and click ripples. The panel has bilingual captions, optional voice, pause, 1x/2x/4x, previous/skip, a chapter list, a progress bar and Stop.
- **Stop and restore:** Stop took 338 ms in the test. The end card offers Restore my previous project.
- **Failures:** a failed check or step shows a message and moves to the next chapter.
- **Script format:** chapters are plain objects (`say`, `move`, `click`, `type`, `key`, `run`, `tab`, `draw`, `do`, `assert`, `ui`); `demo.md` documents them.
- **Template:** the demo registers a "Project 6868 (sample, full)" template when it loads. It reuses the villa starter from the existing `house2` template. Client and site names are neutral ("Sample client", "Sample site").

**Real vs UI-only**
- **Real:** chapter 1 clicks New, picks the template, and types into Project set-up. Chapter 2 clicks the Wall, Floor, Door, Window and Column tools and then clicks on the 3D canvas. Every step is followed by a check on the actual data.
- **UI-only:** chapter 0 is a tour. The Ctrl+K search in it is real. The Open, Save and Projects buttons are only hovered, because the operating system's file dialog can't be shown.

**Tests**
- The demo tests pass: smoke, a full run of chapters 0–2 at 4x, pause/resume/skip/jump/speed, Stop plus restore, and the entry button.
- Your suites pass on the demo build: parity 126, px2 149, freeai 88, link 43, and nodesc found no missing descriptions. The link suite needs the `vendor/` folder next to the test HTML.
- **Not tested:** voice, a 1x speed run, a real GPU and other browsers.
- **Chapter 2 retries:** it retries the door and window clicks up to three times, because it flaked once without retries.

**Decision for you:** the entry-screen button fills the fixed 6868/6868 fields and presses Enter, so the demo starts without typing the password. If you want the password required, delete that one block in `demo_stub.js`.

"""privacy_patch.py  <in.html> <out.html> [privacy.js]

source change that moves a string fails loudly instead of silently skipping.

Every chapter ends in asserts on the data. */\n(function(){\n const S=DEMO, B=S.B, ctx={};\n const sleepq=ms=>S.sleep(ms);\n const qxVal=(name,r,c)=>{ const sh=QX.api.wb().sheets.find(s=>s.name===name); return sh?qxGet(sh,r,c):null; };\n const nrx=()=>ACT.filter(a=>a.src==='rx').length;\n\n /* ---------------- 3: site, survey, excavation, earthworks cost ---------------- */\n S.add({id:'site',n:['Site: survey, excavation and earthworks cost','الموقع: المساحة والحفر وتكلفة الأعمال الترابية'],mode:'real',\n  pre:async()=>{ await S.ensureProject(); },\n  sum:['Import survey points, build the ground surface and contours, compute cut and fill against a design level, then price it in a Q.X sheet.','استيراد نقط المساحة، عمل سطح الأرض والكنتور، حساب القطع والردم على منسوب التصميم، وبعدين تسعيره في شيت Q.X.'],\n  steps:[\n   {op:'say',en:'F.X is the reality-capture and terrain tab. Survey points normally come from a file on your computer (CSV, DXF, LandXML, GPX). The file dialog is outside the browser, so the demo feeds 36 sample points to the same import function.',ar:'F.X هو تاب التقاط الواقع والتضاريس. نقط المساحة عادةً بتيجي من ملف على جهازك (CSV أو DXF أو LandXML أو GPX). نافذة الملف برّه المتصفح، فالديمو بيدّي ٣٦ نقطة تجريبية لنفس دالة الاستيراد.'},\n   {op:'tab',type:'capture'},\n   {op:'assert',en:'F.X tab is open',ar:'تاب F.X مفتوح',ok:()=>ribType()==='capture',wait:5000},\n   {op:'do',fn:async()=>{ let csv='P,E,N,Z\\n',n=1; for(let i=0;i<6;i++)for(let j=0;j<6;j++)csv+=(n++)+','+(i*5)+','+(j*5)+','+(100+.4*i-.3*j+Math.sin(i+j)*.2).toFixed(2)+'\\n'; ctx.imp=await TOX.importSurveyFile({name:'sample_points.csv',text:csv,order:'P,E,N,Z'}); }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'36 survey points imported',ar:'اتستوردت ٣٦ نقطة مساحة',ok:()=>TOX.captureState().points===36},\n   {op:'say',en:'Build the TIN surface from the points with the ribbon button.',ar:'نعمل سطح TIN من النقط بزرار الشريط.'},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'rc_tin',after:600},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Ground surface (TIN) exists',ar:'سطح الأرض (TIN) اتعمل',ok:()=>TOX.captureState().surfaces.length>=1},\n   {op:'do',fn:async()=>{ ctx.cont=await TOX.makeContours({interval:.5}); }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Contours drawn every 0.5 m',ar:'الكنتور اتعمل كل ٠٫٥ م',ok:()=>ctx.cont&&ctx.cont.segments>0},\n   {op:'say',en:'Excavation and backfill: cut and fill of the ground against a design platform level of 100.00 m.',ar:'الحفر والردم: القطع والردم للأرض مقابل منسوب منصة التصميم ١٠٠٫٠٠ م.'},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'rc_qty',after:500},\n   {op:'do',fn:async()=>{ ctx.cf=await TOX.computeCutFill({level:100}); }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Cut and fill volumes computed (m³)',ar:'اتحسبت أحجام القطع والردم (م³)',ok:()=>ctx.cf&&ctx.cf.tin.cut>0&&ctx.cf.tin.fill>0},\n   {op:'say',en:'Cost: a Q.X sheet multiplies the volumes by unit rates. The app ships no price list, so the rates here are SAMPLE placeholders for the demo; type your own.',ar:'التكلفة: شيت Q.X بيضرب الأحجام في أسعار الوحدة. التطبيق مفيهوش قايمة أسعار، فالأسعار هنا تجريبية للديمو؛ اكتب أسعارك.'},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ const c=ctx.cf.tin.cut, f=ctx.cf.tin.fill; QX.addSheet('Earthworks',sh=>{ const P=(r,k,v)=>{ sh.cells[qxK(r,k)]=v; }; ['Item','Quantity m3','Sample rate (placeholder)','Cost'].forEach((t,k)=>P(0,k,t)); P(1,0,'Excavation (cut)'); P(1,1,+c.toFixed(2)); P(1,2,40); P(1,3,'=B2*C2'); P(2,0,'Backfill (fill)'); P(2,1,+f.toFixed(2)); P(2,2,25); P(2,3,'=B3*C3'); P(3,0,'Total'); P(3,3,'=D2+D3'); }); }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Earthworks sheet total = cut × rate + fill × rate',ar:'إجمالي شيت الأعمال الترابية = قطع × سعر + ردم × سعر',ok:()=>{ const t=qxVal('Earthworks',3,3); return typeof t==='number'&&Math.abs(t-(ctx.cf.tin.cut*40+ctx.cf.tin.fill*25))<1; }},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ ctx.site=qxVal('Earthworks',3,3); }},\n   {op:'say',en:'GIS: \"Send the model to the map\" places the building footprint on the G.X map layers.',ar:'GIS: \"ابعت الموديل للخريطة\" بيحط مسقط المبنى على طبقات خريطة G.X.'},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'xf_gis',after:800,soft:1},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Map layers hold features',ar:'طبقات الخريطة فيها عناصر',soft:1,ok:()=>GM.layers.some(l=>l.feat&&l.feat.length>0)}\n  ]});\n\n /* ---------------- 4: P.X schedule linked to the model ---------------- */\n S.add({id:'sched',n:['P.X: schedule from the model (4D / 5D)','P.X: الجدول من الموديل (4D / 5D)'],mode:'real',\n  pre:async()=>{ await S.ensureProject(); },\n  sum:['Send the R.X quantities to P.X, compute the schedule, open the Gantt and link the schedule window to the model window.','ابعت كميات R.X لـP.X، احسب الجدول، افتح الجانت واربط نافذة الجدول بنافذة الموديل.'],\n  steps:[\n   {op:'tab',type:'model'},\n   {op:'say',en:'The schedule is built from the model: \"Send to P.X\" turns each type of work (foundations, walls, slabs, roof...) into activities with durations from quantities divided by productivity.',ar:'الجدول بيتعمل من الموديل: \"ابعت لـP.X\" بيحوّل كل نوع شغل (أساسات وحيطان وبلاطات وسقف...) لأنشطة مدتها الكمية على الإنتاجية.'},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'xf_p6',after:500},\n   {op:'assert',en:'The productivity table opened',ar:'جدول الإنتاجية اتفتح',ok:()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b=>b.textContent.trim()===B('Add to the schedule','ضيف للجدول'))},\n   {op:'move',to:'table.dctab',hold:900,tip:[B('Output per day is a placeholder: use your own productivity','الإنتاجية في اليوم قيمة مبدئية: استخدم إنتاجيتك')]},\n   {op:'click',to:()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()===B('Add to the schedule','ضيف للجدول')),hold:400},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Activities created from the model (WBS 5)',ar:'اتعملت أنشطة من الموديل (WBS 5)',ok:()=>nrx()>=3,wait:5000},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ computeSched(); try{ p6Refresh(); }catch(e){} ctx.fin=ACT.filter(a=>a.src==='rx').slice(-1)[0]; }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Schedule computed: the last activity has a finish date after the start',ar:'اتحسب الجدول: آخر نشاط له تاريخ نهاية بعد البداية',ok:()=>ctx.fin&&ctx.fin.fDate>ctx.fin.sDate},\n   {op:'say',en:'The Gantt chart shows the same activities as bars with the critical path.',ar:'الجانت بيعرض نفس الأنشطة أعمدة مع المسار الحرج.'},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'gantt_open',after:900},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Gantt pane is open',ar:'الجانت مفتوح',ok:()=>{ const l=WX.lay['pane:gantt']; return !!(l&&l.open); }},\n   {op:'say',en:'4D link: link the schedule window with the model window, so selecting an activity shows its work in 3D.',ar:'ربط 4D: نربط نافذة الجدول بنافذة الموديل، فاختيار نشاط يوري شغله في الـ3D.'},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ ctx.lk=TOXAPI.link('sched','model'); }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Schedule and model windows share a link colour',ar:'نافذتا الجدول والموديل ليهم نفس لون الربط',ok:()=>!!ctx.lk&&LK.col(LK.winId('sched')||'sched')===LK.col(LK.winId('model')||'model')}\n  ]});\n\n /* ---------------- 5: structure: quantities, concrete check ---------------- */\n S.add({id:'struct',n:['Structure: concrete quantities and a bending check','الإنشائي: كميات الخرسانة وفحص العزم'],mode:'real',\n  pre:async()=>{ await S.ensureProject(); },\n  sum:['Concrete volumes from the R.X model, then a concrete section flexure and shear check with a code selected.','أحجام الخرسانة من موديل R.X، وبعدين فحص انحناء وقص لقطاع خرساني بكود مختار.'],\n  steps:[\n   {op:'say',en:'Concrete quantities come from the model elements: walls, floor slabs and columns, measured in m³.',ar:'كميات الخرسانة جاية من عناصر الموديل: حيطان وبلاطات وأعمدة بالمتر المكعب.'},\n   {op:'do',fn:async()=>{ ctx.q=rvQty(); const s=QX.api.sync(true); ctx.mq=s&&s.name; }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Model quantities sheet in Q.X, with floor slab volume > 0 m³',ar:'شيت كميات الموديل في Q.X وحجم البلاطات أكبر من صفر',ok:()=>ctx.mq==='Model quantities'&&ctx.q.floor.V>0&&ctx.q.wall.V>0},\n   {op:'say',en:'Reinforcement: R.X has the rebar tool for placing bars; the rebar pane of the Parts tab belongs to the lift-station sample, so it is not shown here.',ar:'التسليح: R.X فيه أداة حديد لوضع الأسياخ؛ أما لوحة الحديد في تاب الأجزاء فتبع نموذج المحطة، فمش بنعرضها هنا.'},\n   {op:'say',en:'Moment check: open Engineering analysis, pick \"Concrete section: flexure and shear\", enter the factored moment and the section, and press Calculate.',ar:'فحص العزم: افتح التحليل الهندسي، اختار \"قطاع خرساني: انحناء وقص\"، دخّل العزم المضروب في المعاملات والقطاع، واضغط احسب.'},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'p_calc',after:700},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Engineering analysis pane is open',ar:'لوحة التحليل الهندسي مفتوحة',ok:()=>!!(typeof calBox!=='undefined'&&calBox&&vis(calBox)),wait:4000},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ CC.id='flex'; CC.code='ACI 318'; CC.vals={}; CC.sheet=null; calPanel(); }},\n   {op:'type',to:()=>calBox.querySelectorAll('input[type=number]')[0],text:'120',tip:false,hold:100},\n   {op:'type',to:()=>calBox.querySelectorAll('input[type=number]')[1],text:'80',tip:false,hold:100},\n   {op:'type',to:()=>calBox.querySelectorAll('input[type=number]')[7],text:'30',tip:false,hold:100},\n   {op:'click',to:()=>[...calBox.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()===B('Calculate','احسب')),hold:300},\n   {op:'assert',en:'The check ran and returned result rows (no FAIL)',ar:'الفحص اتنفذ ورجّع نتايج (من غير FAIL)',ok:()=>CC.sheet&&CC.sheet.rows&&CC.sheet.rows.length>2&&!CC.sheet.rows.some(r=>r[3]==='FAIL')},\n   {op:'say',en:'These numbers are a demonstration of the calculator, not a structural design: the designer enters real loads and checks the code.',ar:'الأرقام دي توضيح للحاسبة مش تصميم إنشائي: المصمم بيدخل أحمال حقيقية ويراجع الكود.'}\n  ]});\n\n /* ---------------- 6: electrical (AC circuits) ---------------- */\n S.add({id:'elec',n:['Electrical: AC unit circuits','الكهرباء: دوائر وحدات التكييف'],mode:'real',\n  pre:async()=>{ await S.ensureProject(); },\n  sum:['Add the rooms in V.X, then create one AC unit per room and read its current, breaker and cable size.','ضيف الغرف في V.X، وبعدين اعمل وحدة تكييف لكل غرفة واقرأ تيارها وقاطعها ومقاس كابلها.'],\n  steps:[\n   {op:'say',en:'The electrical data of the air conditioners follows the rooms. Open V.X and add three rooms.',ar:'بيانات كهرباء التكييف تابعة للغرف. افتح V.X وضيف ٣ غرف.'},\n   {op:'tab',type:'hv'},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ ctx.r0=HVD.rooms.length; }},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'hv_room'},{op:'run',cmd:'hv_room'},{op:'run',cmd:'hv_room'},\n   {op:'assert',en:'3 rooms added',ar:'اتضافت ٣ غرف',ok:()=>HVD.rooms.length-ctx.r0===3},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ const v=HVD.rooms.slice(-3); [['Living',40,6],['Master bedroom',24,3],['Kitchen',16,3]].forEach((x,i)=>{ Object.assign(v[i],{n:x[0],A:x[1],pp:x[2],gS:4,wS:8}); }); hvSave(); hvRender(); }},\n   {op:'say',en:'Now \"Units from cooling load\" creates one AC unit per room and sizes the current, the breaker and the cable.',ar:'دلوقتي \"وحدات من حمل التبريد\" بتعمل وحدة تكييف لكل غرفة وبتحسب التيار والقاطع والكابل.'},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'ace_load',after:800},\n   {op:'assert',en:'AC units created, each with current > 0 A and a breaker size',ar:'اتعملت وحدات التكييف وليها تيار أكبر من صفر وقاطع',ok:()=>ACE.units.length>=3&&ACE.units.every(u=>{ const r=aceCalc(u); return r.I>0&&r.br>0; })},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'ace_open',after:900},\n   {op:'assert',en:'AC electrical pane open',ar:'لوحة كهرباء التكييف مفتوحة',ok:()=>{ const l=WX.lay['pane:acel']; return !!(l&&l.open); }},\n   {op:'say',en:'This covers the AC circuits. Lighting, power panels and cable trays are not calculated in this app yet: the R.X ribbon has their tools as model placeholders only.',ar:'ده بيغطي دوائر التكييف. الإنارة ولوحات الكهرباء وصواني الكابلات مش محسوبة في التطبيق لسه: شريط R.X فيه أدواتها كمكان محجوز بس.'}\n  ]});\n\n /* ---------------- 7: HVAC ---------------- */\n S.add({id:'hvac',n:['HVAC: cooling load and ducts','التكييف: حمل التبريد والمجاري'],mode:'real',\n  pre:async()=>{ await S.ensureProject(); if(HVD.rooms.length<1){ HVD.rooms.push(Object.assign({},HVR,{n:'Room 1',A:30})); hvSave(); } },\n  sum:['Hourly cooling load per room, then duct sizes from the loads.','حمل التبريد بالساعة لكل غرفة، وبعدين مقاسات المجاري من الأحمال.'],\n  steps:[\n   {op:'tab',type:'hv'},\n   {op:'say',en:'V.X computes the cooling load of each room on a design day: walls, glass, people, lights, equipment and ventilation. The design temperatures are editable placeholders.',ar:'V.X بيحسب حمل التبريد لكل غرفة في يوم التصميم: حيطان وزجاج وناس وإضاءة وأجهزة وتهوية. درجات الحرارة قيم مبدئية تتعدل.'},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ ctx.hv=hvCalc(); hvRender(); }},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Cooling load computed for every room',ar:'اتحسب حمل التبريد لكل غرفة',ok:()=>ctx.hv&&ctx.hv.rooms&&ctx.hv.rooms.length===HVD.rooms.length&&JSON.stringify(ctx.hv.rooms[0]).length>200},\n   {op:'say',en:'Duct flows come straight from the room loads.',ar:'تدفقات المجاري جاية مباشرة من أحمال الغرف.'},\n   {op:'do',fn:()=>{ ctx.du0=DUC.secs.length; }},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'du_load',after:800},\n   {op:'assert',en:'Duct sections created from the loads (airflow > 0)',ar:'اتعملت قطاعات مجاري من الأحمال (تدفق أكبر من صفر)',ok:()=>DUC.secs.length>ctx.du0&&DUC.secs.slice(-1)[0].Q>0},\n   {op:'run',cmd:'dp_open',after:700,soft:1},\n   {op:'say',en:'The result is a sizing aid for review by the HVAC engineer, not an approved design.',ar:'النتيجة أداة مساعدة للتحجيم يراجعها مهندس التكييف، مش تصميم معتمد.'}\n  ]});\n const vis=e=>{ if(!e||!e.isConnected)return false; const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width>0&&r.height>0; };\n})();\n"
}

 const mk=()=>{ if(real||dead)return real;
  try{ real=new T.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,canvas:cv}); }catch(e){ dead=true; try{ localStorage.setItem('xto-soft','1'); if(!sessionStorage.getItem('xto-glfb')){ sessionStorage.setItem('xto-glfb','1'); location.reload(); } }catch(x){} return null; }
  real.setPixelRatio(pr); real.localClippingEnabled=true; Object.assign(real.shadowMap,shadow); for(const k in pend)real[k]=pend[k]; if(sz)real.setSize(sz[0],sz[1],false); return real; };
 const tick=t=>{ if(!loop){ raf=0; return; } loop(t); raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
 const own={domElement:cv,
  getPixelRatio:()=>real?real.getPixelRatio():pr,
  setPixelRatio:v=>{ pr=v; if(real)real.setPixelRatio(v); },
  setSize:(w,h,u)=>{ sz=[w,h]; if(real)real.setSize(w,h,u); },
  setAnimationLoop:f=>{ loop=f; if(f&&!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick); else if(!f&&raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=0; } },
  setRenderTarget:(t,...a)=>{ if(!t&&!real){ rt=false; return; } rt=!!t; const r=mk(); if(r)r.setRenderTarget(t,...a); },
  render:(s,c)=>{ if(!real&&!rt&&!cv.clientWidth)return; const r=mk(); if(r)r.render(s,c); }};

---

## Phase 0 - Brief, feasibility and budget
**الفكرة والبرنامج وجدوى الميزانية**

**Purpose.** Turn 'I want a house' into a written brief, a first budget and a go / no-go decision before any design money is spent.

**Inputs**
- Owner wishes: family size, number of bedrooms, parking, garden, future extension (third floor?)
- Plot (owned or candidate), approximate area and location
- Money available (own funds, loan), target handover date
- Local planning rules for the district (permitted height, setbacks, coverage) - from the district technical office, not guessed

**Steps** (status, T.O X ids)

1. [P] Interview the owner and write the design brief (rooms, areas, adjacencies, finish level A/B/C, special needs).
   - T.O X: `o_report`, `lb_ox`  - O.X report editor + document templates can hold the brief; no brief/room-programme tool.
2. [P] Fix the areas: net room programme, then gross built-up area (BUA) = net / efficiency (0.80-0.85 for a villa incl. walls, stair, void).
   - T.O X: `o_sheet`, `qx_open`  - A spreadsheet does it; no dedicated programme sheet.
3. [M] Check plot rules: setbacks, max coverage %, number of floors, max height, parking count, easements.
   - T.O X: (none)  - No zoning / setback checker. Demo can only type the numbers into the project notes.
4. [P] Order-of-magnitude budget = BUA x cost per m2 for the finish level (rule of thumb, from recent local tenders, NOT a design figure); add design fees, permit fees, utilities connection, contingency 10-15 %.
   - T.O X: `dc_tnd`, `dc_fs`, `o_sheet`  - dc_tnd prices a BOQ (overhead, profit, contingency, VAT); dc_fs does NPV/IRR/payback. Neither ships a cost-per-m2 benchmark.
5. [Y] Feasibility if it is an investment (sell/rent): NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity. Skip for an owner-occupied house.
   - T.O X: `dc_fs`  - Inputs are the owner's own numbers.
6. [Y] Risk list at idea stage (soil unknown, permit delay, price escalation, owner changes) with a first mitigation each.
   - T.O X: `p_scen`  - Risk register + Monte Carlo schedule risk.
7. [F] Choose delivery route: design-bid-build with separate consultant and contractor (recommended for a house), or design-build, or owner-managed with labour-only crews.
   - T.O X: (none)  - Decision; affects phase 7.
8. [Y] Go / no-go and sign the brief; open the project file and the document register.
   - T.O X: `new_from_template`, `setup`, `dc_reg`, `tpl:house2`  - tpChooser creates the project; setup stores name/client/number/currency. Template house2 is the R.X starter (see data inventory).

**Outputs / deliverables**
- Signed design brief (1-3 pages)
- Room programme and BUA estimate
- Budget range and funding plan
- Go/no-go record
- Project number and folder / register opened

**Checks and acceptance criteria**
- Brief signed by owner (date on it)
- Budget >= low estimate x 1.1 or scope reduced
